species.name: BULBASAUR
species.dex_text: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.

species.name: IVYSAUR
species.dex_text: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower’s coming bloom.

species.name: VENUSAUR
species.dex_text: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

species.name: CHARMANDER
species.dex_text: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

species.name: CHARMELEON
species.dex_text: In the rocky mountains where CHARMELEON live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

species.name: CHARIZARD
species.dex_text: It is said that CHARIZARD’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

species.name: SQUIRTLE
species.dex_text: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

species.name: WARTORTLE
species.dex_text: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

species.name: BLASTOISE
species.dex_text: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

species.name: CATERPIE
species.dex_text: It releases a stench from its red antenna to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.

species.name: METAPOD
species.dex_text: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.

species.name: BUTTERFREE
species.dex_text: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.

species.name: WEEDLE
species.dex_text: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.

species.name: KAKUNA
species.dex_text: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

species.name: BEEDRILL
species.dex_text: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.

species.name: PIDGEY
species.dex_text: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

species.name: PIDGEOTTO
species.dex_text: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.

species.name: PIDGEOT
species.dex_text: By flapping its wings with all its might, PIDGEOT can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.

species.name: RATTATA
species.dex_text: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.

species.name: RATICATE
species.dex_text: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.

species.name: SPEAROW
species.dex_text: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.

species.name: FEAROW
species.dex_text: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.

species.name: EKANS
species.dex_text: It sneaks through grass without making a sound and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.

species.name: ARBOK
species.dex_text: The pattern on its belly is for intimidation. It constricts foes while they are frozen in fear.

species.name: PIKACHU
species.dex_text: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow PIKACHU that is in a weakened state.

species.name: RAICHU
species.dex_text: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

species.name: SANDSHREW
species.dex_text: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.

species.name: SANDSLASH
species.dex_text: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.

species.name: NIDORAN♀
species.dex_text: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.

species.name: NIDORINA
species.dex_text: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than NIDORINO’s.

species.name: NIDOQUEEN
species.dex_text: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.

species.name: NIDORAN♂
species.dex_text: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

species.name: NIDORINO
species.dex_text: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.

species.name: NIDOKING
species.dex_text: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

species.name: CLEFAIRY
species.dex_text: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of CLEFAIRY dancing under a full moon.

species.name: CLEFABLE
species.dex_text: It is very wary and rarely shows itself to people. Its ears can hear a pin drop over half a mile away.

species.name: VULPIX
species.dex_text: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

species.name: NINETALES
species.dex_text: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.

species.name: JIGGLYPUFF
species.dex_text: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.

species.name: WIGGLYTUFF
species.dex_text: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.

species.name: ZUBAT
species.dex_text: It checks its surroundings and location using reflections of the ultrasonic waves from its mouth.

species.name: GOLBAT
species.dex_text: Its sharp fangs puncture the toughest of hides and have small holes for greedily sucking blood.

species.name: ODDISH
species.dex_text: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.

species.name: GLOOM
species.dex_text: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.

species.name: VILEPLUME
species.dex_text: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.

species.name: PARAS
species.dex_text: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host PARAS.

species.name: PARASECT
species.dex_text: A mushroom grown larger than the host’s body controls PARASECT. It scatters poisonous spores.

species.name: VENONAT
species.dex_text: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

species.name: VENOMOTH
species.dex_text: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.

species.name: DIGLETT
species.dex_text: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.

species.name: DUGTRIO
species.dex_text: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

species.name: MEOWTH
species.dex_text: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

species.name: PERSIAN
species.dex_text: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.

species.name: PSYDUCK
species.dex_text: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.

species.name: GOLDUCK
species.dex_text: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.

species.name: MANKEY
species.dex_text: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

species.name: PRIMEAPE
species.dex_text: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.

species.name: GROWLITHE
species.dex_text: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

species.name: ARCANINE
species.dex_text: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

species.name: POLIWAG
species.dex_text: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.

species.name: POLIWHIRL
species.dex_text: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.

species.name: POLIWRATH
species.dex_text: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.

species.name: ABRA
species.dex_text: Using its psychic power is such a strain on its brain that it needs to sleep for 18 hours a day.

species.name: KADABRA
species.dex_text: It stares at its silver spoon to focus its mind. It emits more alpha waves while doing so.

species.name: ALAKAZAM
species.dex_text: The spoons clutched in its hands are said to have been created by its psychic powers.

species.name: MACHOP
species.dex_text: Though small in stature, it is powerful enough to easily heft and throw a number of GEODUDE at once.

species.name: MACHOKE
species.dex_text: It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.

species.name: MACHAMP
species.dex_text: Its four muscled arms slam foes with powerful punches and chops at blinding speed.

species.name: BELLSPROUT
species.dex_text: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.

species.name: WEEPINBELL
species.dex_text: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.

species.name: VICTREEBEL
species.dex_text: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honeylike scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.

species.name: TENTACOOL
species.dex_text: Because its body is almost entirely composed of water, it shrivels up if it is washed ashore.

species.name: TENTACRUEL
species.dex_text: It extends its 80 tentacles to form an encircling poisonous net that is difficult to escape.

species.name: GEODUDE
species.dex_text: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.

species.name: GRAVELER
species.dex_text: It rolls on mountain paths to move. Once it builds momentum, no Pokémon can stop it without difficulty.

species.name: GOLEM
species.dex_text: Even dynamite can’t harm its hard, boulderlike body. It sheds its hide just once a year.

species.name: PONYTA
species.dex_text: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

species.name: RAPIDASH
species.dex_text: When at an all-out gallop, its blazing mane sparkles, enhancing its beautiful appearance.

species.name: SLOWPOKE
species.dex_text: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.

species.name: SLOWBRO
species.dex_text: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the SHELLDER on its tail bites down.

species.name: MAGNEMITE
species.dex_text: The faster the units at its sides rotate, the greater the magnetic force they generate.

species.name: MAGNETON
species.dex_text: Many mysteriously appear when more sunspots dot the sun. They stop TV sets from displaying properly.

species.name: FARFETCH’D
species.dex_text: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

species.name: DODUO
species.dex_text: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

species.name: DODRIO
species.dex_text: When DODUO evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.

species.name: SEEL
species.dex_text: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.

species.name: DEWGONG
species.dex_text: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.

species.name: GRIMER
species.dex_text: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.

species.name: MUK
species.dex_text: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.

species.name: SHELLDER
species.dex_text: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.

species.name: CLOYSTER
species.dex_text: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.

species.name: GASTLY
species.dex_text: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

species.name: HAUNTER
species.dex_text: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

species.name: GENGAR
species.dex_text: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a GENGAR delighting in casting curses on people.

species.name: ONIX
species.dex_text: It burrows through the ground at a speed of 50 mph while feeding on large boulders.

species.name: DROWZEE
species.dex_text: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.

species.name: HYPNO
species.dex_text: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.

species.name: KRABBY
species.dex_text: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.

species.name: KINGLER
species.dex_text: The larger pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.

species.name: VOLTORB
species.dex_text: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

species.name: ELECTRODE
species.dex_text: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

species.name: EXEGGCUTE
species.dex_text: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

species.name: EXEGGUTOR
species.dex_text: It is called “The Walking Jungle.” If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an EXEGGCUTE.

species.name: CUBONE
species.dex_text: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.

species.name: MAROWAK
species.dex_text: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.

species.name: HITMONLEE
species.dex_text: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.

species.name: HITMONCHAN
species.dex_text: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

species.name: LICKITUNG
species.dex_text: When it extends its over-six-foot- long tongue, its tail quivers. There is a possibility they are connected.

species.name: KOFFING
species.dex_text: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.

species.name: WEEZING
species.dex_text: It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found.

species.name: RHYHORN
species.dex_text: Its powerful tackles can destroy anything. However, it is too slow witted to help people work.

species.name: RHYDON
species.dex_text: Standing on its hind legs freed its forelegs and made it smarter. It is very forgetful, however.

species.name: CHANSEY
species.dex_text: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

species.name: TANGELA
species.dex_text: The blue vines shrouding its body are covered in a growth of fine hair. It is known to be ticklish.

species.name: KANGASKHAN
species.dex_text: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.

species.name: HORSEA
species.dex_text: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

species.name: SEADRA
species.dex_text: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.

species.name: GOLDEEN
species.dex_text: Though it appears very elegant when swimming with fins unfurled, it can jab powerfully with its horn.

species.name: SEAKING
species.dex_text: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.

species.name: STARYU
species.dex_text: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.

species.name: STARMIE
species.dex_text: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

species.name: MR. MIME
species.dex_text: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.

species.name: SCYTHER
species.dex_text: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

species.name: JYNX
species.dex_text: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.

species.name: ELECTABUZZ
species.dex_text: It windmills its arms to slightly boost its punches. Foes have been known to escape in the meantime.

species.name: MAGMAR
species.dex_text: When it breathes deeply, heat waves form around its body, making it hard to see clearly.

species.name: PINSIR
species.dex_text: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can’t tear, it tosses far.

species.name: TAUROS
species.dex_text: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.

species.name: MAGIKARP
species.dex_text: A MAGIKARP living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.

species.name: GYARADOS
species.dex_text: Once it begins to rampage, a GYARADOS will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.

species.name: LAPRAS
species.dex_text: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.

species.name: DITTO
species.dex_text: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.

species.name: EEVEE
species.dex_text: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.

species.name: VAPOREON
species.dex_text: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can melt away into water.

species.name: JOLTEON
species.dex_text: If agitated, it uses electricity to straighten out its fur and launch it in small bunches.

species.name: FLAREON
species.dex_text: Inhaled air is heated in the flame sac in its body to an intense fire over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: PORYGON
species.dex_text: A man-made Pokémon created using advanced scientific means. It can move freely in cyberspace.

species.name: OMANYTE
species.dex_text: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.

species.name: OMASTAR
species.dex_text: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.

species.name: KABUTO
species.dex_text: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.

species.name: KABUTOPS
species.dex_text: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.

species.name: AERODACTYL
species.dex_text: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

species.name: SNORLAX
species.dex_text: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.

species.name: ARTICUNO
species.dex_text: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

species.name: ZAPDOS
species.dex_text: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

species.name: MOLTRES
species.dex_text: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

species.name: DRATINI
species.dex_text: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

species.name: DRAGONAIR
species.dex_text: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.

species.name: DRAGONITE
species.dex_text: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

species.name: MEWTWO
species.dex_text: A Pokémon created by recombining MEW’s genes. It’s said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

species.name: MEW
species.dex_text: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe MEW to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

species.name: CHIKORITA
species.dex_text: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

species.name: BAYLEEF
species.dex_text: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

species.name: MEGANIUM
species.dex_text: Its breath has the fantastic ability to revive dead plants and flowers.

species.name: CYNDAQUIL
species.dex_text: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

species.name: QUILAVA
species.dex_text: It intimidates foes with the heat of its flames. The fire burns more strongly when it readies to fight.

species.name: TYPHLOSION
species.dex_text: It attacks using blasts of fire. It creates heat shimmers with intense fire to hide itself.

species.name: TOTODILE
species.dex_text: It has the habit of biting anything with its developed jaws. Even its Trainer needs to be careful.

species.name: CROCONAW
species.dex_text: Once it bites down, it won’t let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

species.name: FERALIGATR
species.dex_text: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

species.name: SENTRET
species.dex_text: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.

species.name: FURRET
species.dex_text: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.

species.name: HOOTHOOT
species.dex_text: It marks time precisely. Some countries consider it to be a wise friend, versed in the world’s ways.

species.name: NOCTOWL
species.dex_text: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

species.name: LEDYBA
species.dex_text: It is so timid, it can’t move if it isn’t with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.

species.name: LEDIAN
species.dex_text: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.

species.name: SPINARAK
species.dex_text: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.

species.name: ARIADOS
species.dex_text: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.

species.name: CROBAT
species.dex_text: The transformation of its legs into wings made it better at flying, but more clumsy at walking.

species.name: CHINCHOU
species.dex_text: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.

species.name: LANTURN
species.dex_text: LANTURN’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”

species.name: PICHU
species.dex_text: The electric sacs in its cheeks are small. If even a little electricity leaks, it becomes shocked.

species.name: CLEFFA
species.dex_text: It is often seen when shooting stars fill the night skies. It’s said to arrive riding on a shooting star.

species.name: IGGLYBUFF
species.dex_text: It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.

species.name: TOGEPI
species.dex_text: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.

species.name: TOGETIC
species.dex_text: To share its happiness, it flies around the world seeking kind- hearted people.

species.name: NATU
species.dex_text: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.

species.name: XATU
species.dex_text: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.

species.name: MAREEP
species.dex_text: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

species.name: FLAAFFY
species.dex_text: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

species.name: AMPHAROS
species.dex_text: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail’s light.

species.name: BELLOSSOM
species.dex_text: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

species.name: MARILL
species.dex_text: The oil-filled end of its tail floats on water. It keeps MARILL from drowning even in a strong current.

species.name: AZUMARILL
species.dex_text: It can spend all day in water, since it can inhale and store a large volume of air.

species.name: SUDOWOODO
species.dex_text: To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.

species.name: POLITOED
species.dex_text: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make POLIWAG obey.

species.name: HOPPIP
species.dex_text: It drifts on winds. It is said that when HOPPIP gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

species.name: SKIPLOOM
species.dex_text: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.

species.name: JUMPLUFF
species.dex_text: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.

species.name: AIPOM
species.dex_text: It lives high among the treetops. It can use its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.

species.name: SUNKERN
species.dex_text: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. A year after a cold summer, their population explodes.

species.name: SUNFLORA
species.dex_text: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

species.name: YANMA
species.dex_text: It can hover in one spot by flapping its wings at high speed. It flits about to guard its territory.

species.name: WOOPER
species.dex_text: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.

species.name: QUAGSIRE
species.dex_text: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

species.name: ESPEON
species.dex_text: Its fur is so sensitive, it can sense minute shifts in the air and predict the weather.

species.name: UMBREON
species.dex_text: When exposed to the moon’s aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

species.name: MURKROW
species.dex_text: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.

species.name: SLOWKING
species.dex_text: Being bitten by SHELLDER gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.

species.name: MISDREAVUS
species.dex_text: A Pokémon that startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

species.name: UNOWN
species.dex_text: When alone, nothing happens. However, if there are two or more, an odd power is said to emerge.

species.name: WOBBUFFET
species.dex_text: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.

species.name: GIRAFARIG
species.dex_text: The head on its tail contains a small brain. It can instinctively fight even while facing backward.

species.name: PINECO
species.dex_text: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.

species.name: FORRETRESS
species.dex_text: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.

species.name: DUNSPARCE
species.dex_text: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

species.name: GLIGAR
species.dex_text: It glides as if sliding. It startles foes by clamping on to their faces, then jabs with its poison stinger.

species.name: STEELIX
species.dex_text: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

species.name: SNUBBULL
species.dex_text: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.

species.name: GRANBULL
species.dex_text: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.

species.name: QWILFISH
species.dex_text: It shoots the poison spines on its body in all directions. Its round form makes it a poor swimmer.

species.name: SCIZOR
species.dex_text: It raises its pincers with eyelike markings for intimidation. It also swings them down dangerously.

species.name: SHUCKLE
species.dex_text: It stores berries in its shell. The berries eventually ferment to become delicious juices.

species.name: HERACROSS
species.dex_text: It loves sweet honey. To keep all the honey to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

species.name: SNEASEL
species.dex_text: A smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.

species.name: TEDDIURSA
species.dex_text: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.

species.name: URSARING
species.dex_text: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.

species.name: SLUGMA
species.dex_text: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn’t keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

species.name: MAGCARGO
species.dex_text: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.

species.name: SWINUB
species.dex_text: It has a very sensitive nose. It can locate mushrooms, berries, and even hot springs buried under ice.

species.name: PILOSWINE
species.dex_text: Covered by a shaggy coat, it is strong against the cold. Its tusks of ice thicken when it snows.

species.name: CORSOLA
species.dex_text: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.

species.name: REMORAID
species.dex_text: It forcefully squirts water. The water jet never misses prey even if the REMORAID is deep in the sea.

species.name: OCTILLERY
species.dex_text: It loves to lurk inside holes in rocks. It sometimes sprays ink on prey by sticking out only its mouth.

species.name: DELIBIRD
species.dex_text: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.

species.name: MANTINE
species.dex_text: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores REMORAID that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.

species.name: SKARMORY
species.dex_text: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.

species.name: HOUNDOUR
species.dex_text: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

species.name: HOUNDOOM
species.dex_text: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

species.name: KINGDRA
species.dex_text: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.

species.name: PHANPY
species.dex_text: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

species.name: DONPHAN
species.dex_text: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.

species.name: PORYGON2
species.dex_text: It was upgraded to enable the exploration of other planets. However, it failed to measure up.

species.name: STANTLER
species.dex_text: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.

species.name: SMEARGLE
species.dex_text: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.

species.name: TYROGUE
species.dex_text: It is famous for its eagerness to fight and always nurses injuries from challenging larger foes.

species.name: HITMONTOP
species.dex_text: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by ten.

species.name: SMOOCHUM
species.dex_text: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.

species.name: ELEKID
species.dex_text: A weak electric current flows between its horns. Sticking a hand there shocks the unwary.

species.name: MAGBY
species.dex_text: Its magma-like blood circulates throughout its body. Its body’s heat can top 1,100 degrees F.

species.name: MILTANK
species.dex_text: It is said that kids who drink MILTANK’s milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.

species.name: BLISSEY
species.dex_text: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

species.name: RAIKOU
species.dex_text: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.

species.name: ENTEI
species.dex_text: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

species.name: SUICUNE
species.dex_text: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

species.name: LARVITAR
species.dex_text: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.

species.name: PUPITAR
species.dex_text: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.

species.name: TYRANITAR
species.dex_text: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

species.name: LUGIA
species.dex_text: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

species.name: HO-OH
species.dex_text: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.

species.name: CELEBI
species.dex_text: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

species.name: TREECKO
species.dex_text: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

species.name: GROVYLE
species.dex_text: It lives in dense jungles. While  closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

species.name: SCEPTILE
species.dex_text: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.

species.name: TORCHIC
species.dex_text: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.

species.name: COMBUSKEN
species.dex_text: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.

species.name: BLAZIKEN
species.dex_text: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.

species.name: MUDKIP
species.dex_text: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

species.name: MARSHTOMP
species.dex_text: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.

species.name: SWAMPERT
species.dex_text: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

species.name: POOCHYENA
species.dex_text: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

species.name: MIGHTYENA
species.dex_text: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.

species.name: ZIGZAGOON
species.dex_text: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.

species.name: LINOONE
species.dex_text: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.

species.name: WURMPLE
species.dex_text: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.

species.name: SILCOON
species.dex_text: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.

species.name: BEAUTIFLY
species.dex_text: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.

species.name: CASCOON
species.dex_text: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

species.name: DUSTOX
species.dex_text: Toxic powder is scattered with each flap. At night, it is known to strip leaves off trees lining boulevards.

species.name: LOTAD
species.dex_text: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can’t swim.

species.name: LOMBRE
species.dex_text: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

species.name: LUDICOLO
species.dex_text: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.

species.name: SEEDOT
species.dex_text: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

species.name: NUZLEAF
species.dex_text: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.

species.name: SHIFTRY
species.dex_text: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

species.name: TAILLOW
species.dex_text: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

species.name: SWELLOW
species.dex_text: It circles the sky in search of prey. When it spots one, it dives steeply to catch the prey.

species.name: WINGULL
species.dex_text: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

species.name: PELIPPER
species.dex_text: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

species.name: RALTS
species.dex_text: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

species.name: KIRLIA
species.dex_text: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

species.name: GARDEVOIR
species.dex_text: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

species.name: SURSKIT
species.dex_text: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

species.name: MASQUERAIN
species.dex_text: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

species.name: SHROOMISH
species.dex_text: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

species.name: BRELOOM
species.dex_text: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

species.name: SLAKOTH
species.dex_text: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.

species.name: VIGOROTH
species.dex_text: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.

species.name: SLAKING
species.dex_text: The world’s laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

species.name: NINCADA
species.dex_text: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.

species.name: NINJASK
species.dex_text: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

species.name: SHEDINJA
species.dex_text: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one’s spirit.

species.name: WHISMUR
species.dex_text: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.

species.name: LOUDRED
species.dex_text: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

species.name: EXPLOUD
species.dex_text: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

species.name: MAKUHITA
species.dex_text: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

species.name: HARIYAMA
species.dex_text: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.

species.name: AZURILL
species.dex_text: Its tail bounces like a rubber ball. It flings that tail around to fight opponents bigger than itself.

species.name: NOSEPASS
species.dex_text: When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.

species.name: SKITTY
species.dex_text: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

species.name: DELCATTY
species.dex_text: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

species.name: SABLEYE
species.dex_text: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

species.name: MAWILE
species.dex_text: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

species.name: ARON
species.dex_text: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

species.name: LAIRON
species.dex_text: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.

species.name: AGGRON
species.dex_text: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

species.name: MEDITITE
species.dex_text: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.

species.name: MEDICHAM
species.dex_text: It gains the ability to see the aura of its opponents by honing its mind through starvation.

species.name: ELECTRIKE
species.dex_text: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

species.name: MANECTRIC
species.dex_text: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

species.name: PLUSLE
species.dex_text: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

species.name: MINUN
species.dex_text: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

species.name: VOLBEAT
species.dex_text: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves ILLUMISE’s sweet aroma.

species.name: ILLUMISE
species.dex_text: With its sweet aroma, it guides VOLBEAT to draw signs with light in the night sky.

species.name: ROSELIA
species.dex_text: The more healthy the ROSELIA, the more pleasant its flowers’ aroma. Its scent deeply relaxes people.

species.name: GULPIN
species.dex_text: Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.

species.name: SWALOT
species.dex_text: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.

species.name: CARVANHA
species.dex_text: They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.

species.name: SHARPEDO
species.dex_text: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as “The Bully of the Sea.”

species.name: WAILMER
species.dex_text: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.

species.name: WAILORD
species.dex_text: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.

species.name: NUMEL
species.dex_text: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

species.name: CAMERUPT
species.dex_text: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.

species.name: TORKOAL
species.dex_text: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

species.name: SPOINK
species.dex_text: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.

species.name: GRUMPIG
species.dex_text: It uses black pearls to amplify its psycho-power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

species.name: SPINDA
species.dex_text: No two SPINDA have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

species.name: TRAPINCH
species.dex_text: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

species.name: VIBRAVA
species.dex_text: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.

species.name: FLYGON
species.dex_text: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as “The Desert Spirit.”

species.name: CACNEA
species.dex_text: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.

species.name: CACTURNE
species.dex_text: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day’s desert heat.

species.name: SWABLU
species.dex_text: It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

species.name: ALTARIA
species.dex_text: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

species.name: ZANGOOSE
species.dex_text: It has feuded with SEVIPER for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.

species.name: SEVIPER
species.dex_text: For many generations, it has feuded with ZANGOOSE. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.

species.name: LUNATONE
species.dex_text: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

species.name: SOLROCK
species.dex_text: A new Pokémon species, rumored to be from the sun. It gives off light while spinning.

species.name: BARBOACH
species.dex_text: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.

species.name: WHISCASH
species.dex_text: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.

species.name: CORPHISH
species.dex_text: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.

species.name: CRAWDAUNT
species.dex_text: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.

species.name: BALTOY
species.dex_text: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

species.name: CLAYDOL
species.dex_text: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.

species.name: LILEEP
species.dex_text: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.

species.name: CRADILY
species.dex_text: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.

species.name: ANORITH
species.dex_text: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.

species.name: ARMALDO
species.dex_text: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.

species.name: FEEBAS
species.dex_text: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

species.name: MILOTIC
species.dex_text: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.

species.name: CASTFORM
species.dex_text: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.

species.name: KECLEON
species.dex_text: It can freely change its body’s color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn’t change, however.

species.name: SHUPPET
species.dex_text: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

species.name: BANETTE
species.dex_text: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.

species.name: DUSKULL
species.dex_text: It loves the crying of children. It startles bad kids by passing through walls and making them cry.

species.name: DUSCLOPS
species.dex_text: It seeks drifting will-o’-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.

species.name: TROPIUS
species.dex_text: Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.

species.name: CHIMECHO
species.dex_text: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.

species.name: ABSOL
species.dex_text: Rumored to sense disasters with its horn, it became a target. It fled deep into the mountains.

species.name: WYNAUT
species.dex_text: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.

species.name: SNORUNT
species.dex_text: It is said that several SNORUNT gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.

species.name: GLALIE
species.dex_text: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.

species.name: SPHEAL
species.dex_text: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.

species.name: SEALEO
species.dex_text: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.

species.name: WALREIN
species.dex_text: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

species.name: CLAMPERL
species.dex_text: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.

species.name: HUNTAIL
species.dex_text: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.

species.name: GOREBYSS
species.dex_text: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.

species.name: RELICANTH
species.dex_text: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

species.name: LUVDISC
species.dex_text: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.

species.name: BAGON
species.dex_text: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

species.name: SHELGON
species.dex_text: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

species.name: SALAMENCE
species.dex_text: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.

species.name: BELDUM
species.dex_text: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

species.name: METANG
species.dex_text: It is formed by two BELDUM joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.

species.name: METAGROSS
species.dex_text: METANG combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

species.name: REGIROCK
species.dex_text: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.

species.name: REGICE
species.dex_text: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: REGISTEEL
species.dex_text: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.

species.name: LATIAS
species.dex_text: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.

species.name: LATIOS
species.dex_text: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

species.name: KYOGRE
species.dex_text: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

species.name: GROUDON
species.dex_text: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought KYOGRE long ago.

species.name: RAYQUAZA
species.dex_text: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

species.name: JIRACHI
species.dex_text: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

species.name: DEOXYS
species.dex_text: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

species.name: TURTWIG
species.dex_text: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy TURTWIG, the shell should feel moist.

species.name: GROTLE
species.dex_text: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

species.name: TORTERRA
species.dex_text: Some Pokémon are born on a TORTERRA’s back and spend their entire life there.

species.name: CHIMCHAR
species.dex_text: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.

species.name: MONFERNO
species.dex_text: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

species.name: INFERNAPE
species.dex_text: It uses unique fighting moves with fire on its hands and feet. It will take on any opponent.

species.name: PIPLUP
species.dex_text: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

species.name: PRINPLUP
species.dex_text: Because every PRINPLUP considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.

species.name: EMPOLEON
species.dex_text: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

species.name: STARLY
species.dex_text: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

species.name: STARAVIA
species.dex_text: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a STARAVIA cries noisily.

species.name: STARAPTOR
species.dex_text: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.

species.name: BIDOOF
species.dex_text: A comparison revealed that BIDOOF’s front teeth grow at the same rate as RATTATA’s.

species.name: BIBAREL
species.dex_text: A river dammed by BIBAREL will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.

species.name: KRICKETOT
species.dex_text: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.

species.name: KRICKETUNE
species.dex_text: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

species.name: SHINX
species.dex_text: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

species.name: LUXIO
species.dex_text: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

species.name: LUXRAY
species.dex_text: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

species.name: BUDEW
species.dex_text: Sensitive to changing temperature, the bud is said to bloom when it feels the sun’s warm touch.

species.name: ROSERADE
species.dex_text: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.

species.name: CRANIDOS
species.dex_text: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, it would snap obstructing trees with head butts.

species.name: RAMPARDOS
species.dex_text: If two were to smash their heads together, their foot-thick skulls would keep them from fainting.

species.name: SHIELDON
species.dex_text: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.

species.name: BASTIODON
species.dex_text: When they lined up side by side, no foe could break through. They shielded their young in that way.

species.name: BURMY
species.dex_text: Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.

species.name: WORMADAM
species.dex_text: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.

species.name: MOTHIM
species.dex_text: While it loves floral honey, it won’t gather any itself. Instead, it plots to steal some from COMBEE.

species.name: COMBEE
species.dex_text: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please VESPIQUEN.

species.name: VESPIQUEN
species.dex_text: It releases various pheromones to make the grubs in its body do its bidding while fighting foes.

species.name: PACHIRISU
species.dex_text: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

species.name: BUIZEL
species.dex_text: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

species.name: FLOATZEL
species.dex_text: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.

species.name: CHERUBI
species.dex_text: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. STARLY try to peck it off.

species.name: CHERRIM
species.dex_text: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun’s rays with its whole body.

species.name: SHELLOS
species.dex_text: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.

species.name: GASTRODON
species.dex_text: Long ago, its entire back was shielded with a sturdy shell. There are traces of it left in its cells.

species.name: AMBIPOM
species.dex_text: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, AMBIPOM rarely uses its hands.

species.name: DRIFLOON
species.dex_text: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “Signpost for Wandering Spirits.”

species.name: DRIFBLIM
species.dex_text: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.

species.name: BUNEARY
species.dex_text: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.

species.name: LOPUNNY
species.dex_text: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.

species.name: MISMAGIUS
species.dex_text: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

species.name: HONCHKROW
species.dex_text: If one utters a deep cry, many MURKROW gather quickly. For this, it is called “Summoner of Night.”

species.name: GLAMEOW
species.dex_text: It hides its spiteful tendency of hooking its claws into the nose of its Trainer if it isn’t fed.

species.name: PURUGLY
species.dex_text: It binds its body with its tails to make itself look bigger. If it locks eyes, it will glare ceaselessly.

species.name: CHINGLING
species.dex_text: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.

species.name: STUNKY
species.dex_text: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.

species.name: SKUNTANK
species.dex_text: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.

species.name: BRONZOR
species.dex_text: There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.

species.name: BRONZONG
species.dex_text: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.

species.name: BONSLY
species.dex_text: It prefers an arid atmosphere. It leaks water that looks like tears when adjusting its moisture level.

species.name: MIME JR.
species.dex_text: It mimics the expressions and motions of those it sees to understand the feelings of others.

species.name: HAPPINY
species.dex_text: It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others’ feet and cause them to stumble.

species.name: CHATOT
species.dex_text: Its tongue is just like a human’s. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.

species.name: SPIRITOMB
species.dex_text: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

species.name: GIBLE
species.dex_text: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.

species.name: GABITE
species.dex_text: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

species.name: GARCHOMP
species.dex_text: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.

species.name: MUNCHLAX
species.dex_text: In its desperation to gulp down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.

species.name: RIOLU
species.dex_text: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

species.name: LUCARIO
species.dex_text: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

species.name: HIPPOPOTAS
species.dex_text: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.

species.name: HIPPOWDON
species.dex_text: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.

species.name: SKORUPI
species.dex_text: As soon as the tail claws close, its needle tips secrete poison. It can survive a year without food.

species.name: DRAPION
species.dex_text: Possessing a sturdy build, it takes pride in its strength, taking down foes without using toxins.

species.name: CROAGUNK
species.dex_text: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.

species.name: TOXICROAK
species.dex_text: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.

species.name: CARNIVINE
species.dex_text: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling drool and gulps them down.

species.name: FINNEON
species.dex_text: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.

species.name: LUMINEON
species.dex_text: It crawls along the seafloor using its long front fins like legs. It competes for food with LANTURN.

species.name: MANTYKE
species.dex_text: People organize tours to see this Pokémon frolic and skim the tops of waves with REMORAID.

species.name: SNOVER
species.dex_text: Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.

species.name: ABOMASNOW
species.dex_text: They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.

species.name: WEAVILE
species.dex_text: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

species.name: MAGNEZONE
species.dex_text: A group tried to use scientific means to make MAGNEZONE evolve, but their efforts ended in failure.

species.name: LICKILICKY
species.dex_text: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness.

species.name: RHYPERIOR
species.dex_text: It can launch a rock held in its hand like a missile by tightening then expanding muscles instantly.

species.name: TANGROWTH
species.dex_text: Its arms are made of plants that bind themselves to things. They grow back right away if cut.

species.name: ELECTIVIRE
species.dex_text: Heedless of enemy attacks, it closes in, shoves its tails onto the foe, then looses high voltage.

species.name: MAGMORTAR
species.dex_text: When launching 3,600 degrees F fireballs, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.

species.name: TOGEKISS
species.dex_text: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another’s rights and avoid needless strife.

species.name: YANMEGA
species.dex_text: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.

species.name: LEAFEON
species.dex_text: It basically does not fight. With cells similar to those of plants, it can perform photosynthesis.

species.name: GLACEON
species.dex_text: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.

species.name: GLISCOR
species.dex_text: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.

species.name: MAMOSWINE
species.dex_text: A frozen one was dug up from soil dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to much amazement.

species.name: PORYGON-Z
species.dex_text: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.

species.name: GALLADE
species.dex_text: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.

species.name: PROBOPASS
species.dex_text: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

species.name: DUSKNOIR
species.dex_text: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

species.name: FROSLASS
species.dex_text: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

species.name: ROTOM
species.dex_text: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

species.name: UXIE
species.dex_text: When UXIE flew, people gained the ability to solve problems. It was the birth of knowledge.

species.name: MESPRIT
species.dex_text: When MESPRIT flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions.

species.name: AZELF
species.dex_text: When AZELF flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower.

species.name: DIALGA
species.dex_text: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when DIALGA’s heart beats.

species.name: PALKIA
species.dex_text: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with PALKIA’s every breath.

species.name: HEATRAN
species.dex_text: Its body is made of rugged steel. However, it is partially melted in spots because of its own heat.

species.name: REGIGIGAS
species.dex_text: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

species.name: GIRATINA
species.dex_text: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

species.name: CRESSELIA
species.dex_text: On nights around the quarter moon, the aurora from its tail extends and undulates beautifully.

species.name: PHIONE
species.dex_text: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

species.name: MANAPHY
species.dex_text: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

species.name: DARKRAI
species.dex_text: To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.

species.name: SHAYMIN
species.dex_text: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.

species.name: ARCEUS
species.dex_text: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing, then shaped the world.

moves.name: Pound
moves.description: The foe is physically pounded with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.

moves.name: Karate Chop
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a sharp chop. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: DoubleSlap
moves.description: The foe is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Comet Punch
moves.description: The foe is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Mega Punch
moves.description: The foe is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.

moves.name: Pay Day
moves.description: Numerous coins are hurled at the foe to inflict damage. Money is earned after battle.

moves.name: Fire Punch
moves.description: The foe is punched with a fiery fist. It may leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Ice Punch
moves.description: The foe is punched with an icy fist. It may leave the target frozen.

moves.name: ThunderPunch
moves.description: The foe is punched with an electrified fist. It may leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Scratch
moves.description: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the foe to inflict damage.

moves.name: ViceGrip
moves.description: Huge, impressive pincers grip and squeeze the foe.

moves.name: Guillotine
moves.description: A vicious, tearing attack with pincers. The foe will faint instantly if this attack hits.

moves.name: Razor Wind
moves.description: A two-turn attack. Blades of wind hit the foe on the second turn. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Cut
moves.description: The foe is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.

moves.name: Gust
moves.description: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the foe to inflict damage.

moves.name: Wing Attack
moves.description: The foe is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.

moves.name: Whirlwind
moves.description: The foe is blown away, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

moves.name: Fly
moves.description: The user soars, then strikes on the second turn. It can also be used for flying to any familiar town.

moves.name: Bind
moves.description: A long body or tentacles are used to bind and squeeze the foe for two to five turns.

moves.name: Slam
moves.description: The foe is slammed with a long tail, vines, etc., to inflict damage.

moves.name: Vine Whip
moves.description: The foe is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.

moves.name: Stomp
moves.description: The foe is stomped with a big foot. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Double Kick
moves.description: The foe is quickly kicked twice in succession using both feet.

moves.name: Mega Kick
moves.description: The foe is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.

moves.name: Jump Kick
moves.description: The user jumps up high, then strikes with a kick. If the kick misses, the user hurts itself.

moves.name: Rolling Kick
moves.description: The user cuts a quick spin and lashes out with a sharp kick.

moves.name: Sand-Attack
moves.description: Sand is hurled in the foe’s face, reducing its accuracy.

moves.name: Headbutt
moves.description: The user sticks its head out and rams straight forward. It may make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Horn Attack
moves.description: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.

moves.name: Fury Attack
moves.description: The foe is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Horn Drill
moves.description: The foe is stabbed with a horn rotating like a drill. The foe instantly faints if it hits.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the foe with its whole body.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user drops onto the foe with its full body weight. It may leave the foe paralyzed.

moves.name: Wrap
moves.description: A long body or vines are used to wrap and squeeze the foe for two to five turns.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the foe. It also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Thrash
moves.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life- risking tackle. It also damages the user by a fairly large amount, however.

moves.name: Tail Whip
moves.description: The user wags its tail cutely, making the foe less wary. The target’s Defense stat is lowered.

moves.name: Poison Sting
moves.description: The foe is stabbed with a poisonous barb of some sort. It may also poison the target.

moves.name: Twineedle
moves.description: The foe is stabbed twice by a pair of stingers. It may also poison the target.

moves.name: Pin Missile
moves.description: Sharp pins are shot at the foe in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Leer
moves.description: The foe is given an intimidating leer with sharp eyes. The target’s Defense stat is reduced.

moves.name: Bite
moves.description: The foe is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. It may make the target flinch.

moves.name: Growl
moves.description: The user growls in an endearing way, making the foe less wary. The target’s Attack stat is lowered.

moves.name: Roar
moves.description: The foe is scared off, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

moves.name: Sing
moves.description: A soothing lullaby is sung in a calming voice that puts the foe into a deep slumber.

moves.name: Supersonic
moves.description: The user generates odd sound waves from its body. It may confuse the target.

moves.name: SonicBoom
moves.description: The foe is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.

moves.name: Disable
moves.description: For several turns, this move prevents the foe from using the move it last used.

moves.name: Acid
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a spray of harsh acid. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Ember
moves.description: The foe is attacked with small flames. The target may also be left with a burn.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.description: The foe is scorched with an intense blast of fire. The target may also be left with a burn.

moves.name: Mist
moves.description: The user cloaks its body with a white mist that prevents any of its stats from being cut for five turns.

moves.name: Water Gun
moves.description: The foe is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: The foe is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

moves.name: Surf
moves.description: It swamps the entire battlefield with a giant wave. It can also be used for crossing water.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: The foe is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the foe. It may also freeze the target solid.

moves.name: Psybeam
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a peculiar ray. It may also leave the target confused.

moves.name: BubbleBeam
moves.description: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Aurora Beam
moves.description: The foe is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. It may also lower the target’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

moves.name: Peck
moves.description: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.

moves.name: Drill Peck
moves.description: A corkscrewing attack with the sharp beak acting as a drill.

moves.name: Submission
moves.description: The user grabs the foe and recklessly dives for the ground. It also hurts the user slightly.

moves.name: Low Kick
moves.description: A powerful low kick that makes the foe fall over. It inflicts greater damage on heavier foes.

moves.name: Counter
moves.description: A retaliation move that counters any physical attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

moves.name: Seismic Toss
moves.description: The foe is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.

moves.name: Strength
moves.description: The foe is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move boulders.

moves.name: Absorb
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Mega Drain
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Leech Seed
moves.description: A seed is planted on the foe. It steals some HP from the foe to heal the user on every turn.

moves.name: Growth
moves.description: The user’s body is forced to grow all at once. It raises the Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Razor Leaf
moves.description: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: SolarBeam
moves.description: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

moves.name: PoisonPowder
moves.description: A cloud of poisonous dust is scattered on the foe. It may poison the target.

moves.name: Stun Spore
moves.description: The user scatters a cloud of paralyzing powder. It may paralyze the target.

moves.name: Sleep Powder
moves.description: The user scatters a big cloud of sleep- inducing dust around the foe.

moves.name: Petal Dance
moves.description: The user attacks by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

moves.name: String Shot
moves.description: The foe is bound with silk blown from the user’s mouth. It reduces the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Dragon Rage
moves.description: The foe is stricken by a shock wave. This attack always inflicts 40 HP damage.

moves.name: Fire Spin
moves.description: The foe becomes trapped within a fierce vortex of fire that rages for two to five turns.

moves.name: ThunderShock
moves.description: A jolt of electricity is hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the foe paralyzed.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: A strong electric blast is loosed at the foe. It may also leave the foe paralyzed.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: A weak electric charge is launched at the foe. It causes paralysis if it hits.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

moves.name: Rock Throw
moves.description: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the foe to attack.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.description: The user sets off an earthquake that hits all the Pokémon in the battle.

moves.name: Fissure
moves.description: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the foe in. The target instantly faints if it hits.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Confusion
moves.description: The foe is hit by a weak telekinetic force. It may also leave the foe confused.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: The foe is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall into a deep sleep.

moves.name: Meditate
moves.description: The user meditates to awaken the power deep within its body and raise its Attack stat.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. It sharply boosts the Speed stat.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: The user lunges at the foe at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.

moves.name: Rage
moves.description: While this move is in use, it gains attack power each time the user is hit in battle.

moves.name: Teleport
moves.description: Use it to flee from any wild Pokémon. It may also be used to warp to the last Poké Center visited.

moves.name: Night Shade
moves.description: The user makes the foe see a mirage. It inflicts damage matching the user’s level.

moves.name: Mimic
moves.description: The user copies the move last used by the foe. The move can be used for the rest of the battle.

moves.name: Screech
