moves.description: An earsplitting screech is emitted to sharply reduce the foe’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

moves.name: Recover
moves.description: A self-healing move. The user restores its own HP by up to half of its max HP.

moves.name: Harden
moves.description: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.

moves.name: Minimize
moves.description: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller. The user’s evasion stat is boosted.

moves.name: SmokeScreen
moves.description: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. It reduces the foe’s accuracy.

moves.name: Confuse Ray
moves.description: The foe is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.

moves.name: Withdraw
moves.description: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.

moves.name: Defense Curl
moves.description: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.

moves.name: Barrier
moves.description: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Haze
moves.description: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Focus Energy
moves.description: The user takes a deep breath and focuses to raise the critical-hit ratio of its attacks.

moves.name: Bide
moves.description: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.

moves.name: Metronome
moves.description: The user waggles a finger and stimulates the brain into randomly using nearly any move.

moves.name: Mirror Move
moves.description: The user counters the foe by mimicking the move last used by the foe.

moves.name: Selfdestruct
moves.description: The user blows up to inflict damage on all Pokémon in battle. The user faints upon using this move.

moves.name: Egg Bomb
moves.description: A large egg is hurled with maximum force at the foe to inflict damage.

moves.name: Lick
moves.description: The foe is licked with a long tongue, causing damage. It may also paralyze the target.

moves.name: Smog
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. It may also poison the target.

moves.name: Sludge
moves.description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the foe. It may also poison the target.

moves.name: Bone Club
moves.description: The user clubs the foe with a bone. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Fire Blast
moves.description: The foe is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Waterfall
moves.description: The user charges the foe at an awesome speed. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.

moves.name: Clamp
moves.description: The foe is clamped and squeezed by the user’s very thick and sturdy shell for two to five turns.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the foe. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Skull Bash
moves.description: The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense in the first turn, then rams the foe on the next turn.

moves.name: Spike Cannon
moves.description: Sharp spikes are fired at the foe to strike two to five times in rapid succession.

moves.name: Constrict
moves.description: The foe is attacked with long, creeping tentacles or vines. It may also lower the target’s Speed.

moves.name: Amnesia
moves.description: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Kinesis
moves.description: The user distracts the foe by bending a spoon. It may lower the target’s accuracy.

moves.name: Softboiled
moves.description: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. It may also be used to heal an ally’s HP.

moves.name: Hi Jump Kick
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If it misses, the user is hurt instead.

moves.name: Glare
moves.description: The user intimidates the foe with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.

moves.name: Dream Eater
moves.description: An attack that works only on a sleeping foe. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user’s HP.

moves.name: Poison Gas
moves.description: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the foe’s face. It may poison the target.

moves.name: Barrage
moves.description: Round objects are hurled at the foe to strike two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Leech Life

moves.description: The user swings and hits with its strong and heavy fist. It lowers the user’s Speed, however.

moves.name: Gyro Ball
moves.description: The user tackles the foe with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

moves.name: Healing Wish
moves.description: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status cured.

moves.name: Brine
moves.description: If the foe’s HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.

moves.name: Natural Gift
moves.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

moves.name: Feint
moves.description: An attack that hits a foe using Protect or Detect. It also lifts the effects of those moves.

moves.name: Pluck
moves.description: The user pecks the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user plucks it and gains its effect.

moves.name: Tailwind
moves.description: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that ups the Speed of all party Pokémon for three turns.

moves.name: Acupressure
moves.description: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its stats.

moves.name: Metal Burst
moves.description: The user retaliates against the foe that last inflicted damage on it with much greater power.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.description: The user fights the foe in close without guarding itself. It also cuts the user’s Defense and Sp. Def.

moves.name: Payback
moves.description: If the user can use this attack after the foe attacks, its power is doubled.

moves.name: Assurance
moves.description: If the foe has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack’s power is doubled.

moves.name: Embargo
moves.description: It prevents the foe from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

moves.name: Fling
moves.description: The user flings its held item at the foe to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

moves.name: Psycho Shift
moves.description: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status problems to the target.

moves.name: Trump Card
moves.description: The fewer PP this move has, the more power it has for attack.

moves.name: Heal Block
moves.description: The user prevents the foe from using any HP-recovery moves for five turns.

moves.name: Wring Out
moves.description: The user powerfully wrings the foe. The more HP the foe has, the greater this attack’s power.

moves.name: Power Trick
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack with its Defense stat.

moves.name: Gastro Acid
moves.description: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the foe. The fluid eliminates the effect of the foe’s ability.

moves.name: Lucky Chant
moves.description: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing the foe from landing critical hits.

moves.name: Me First
moves.description: The user tries to cut ahead of the foe to steal and use the foe’s intended move with greater power.

moves.name: Copycat
moves.description: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.

moves.name: Power Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk with the foe.

moves.name: Guard Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def with the foe.

moves.name: Punishment
moves.description: This attack’s power increases the more the foe has powered up with stat changes.

moves.name: Last Resort
moves.description: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

moves.name: Worry Seed
moves.description: A seed that causes worry is planted on the foe. It prevents sleep by making its ability Insomnia.

moves.name: Sucker Punch
moves.description: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the foe is not readying an attack, however.

moves.name: Toxic Spikes
moves.description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the foe’s feet. They poison foes that switch into battle.

moves.name: Heart Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the foe.

moves.name: Aqua Ring
moves.description: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP on every turn.

moves.name: Magnet Rise
moves.description: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

moves.name: Flare Blitz
moves.description: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the foe. The user sustains serious damage, too.

moves.name: Force Palm
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a shock wave. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

moves.name: Aura Sphere
moves.description: The user looses a blast of aura power from deep within its body. This move is certain to hit.

moves.name: Rock Polish
moves.description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The foe is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. It may also poison the foe.

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Night Slash
moves.description: The user slashes the foe the instant an opportunity arises. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Aqua Tail
moves.description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

moves.name: Seed Bomb
moves.description: The user slams a barrage of hard- shelled seeds down on the foe from above.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: X-Scissor
moves.description: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

moves.name: Bug Buzz
moves.description: The user vibrates its wings to generate a damaging sound wave. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Dragon Pulse
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user’s gaping mouth.

moves.name: Dragon Rush
moves.description: The user tackles the foe while exhibiting overwhelming menace. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Power Gem
moves.description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

moves.name: Drain Punch
moves.description: An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Vacuum Wave
moves.description: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the foe. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Focus Blast
moves.description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

moves.name: Brave Bird
moves.description: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. The user also takes serious damage.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the foe erupt with power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

moves.name: Switcheroo
moves.description: The user trades held items with the foe faster than the eye can follow.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

moves.name: Nasty Plot
moves.description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk.

moves.name: Bullet Punch
moves.description: The user strikes with a tough punch as fast as a bullet. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Avalanche
moves.description: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

moves.name: Ice Shard
moves.description: The user flash freezes chunks of ice and hurls them. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Shadow Claw
moves.description: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Thunder Fang
moves.description: The user bites with electrified fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or become paralyzed.

moves.name: Ice Fang
moves.description: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or freeze.

moves.name: Fire Fang
moves.description: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or sustain a burn.

moves.name: Shadow Sneak
moves.description: The user extends its shadow and attacks the foe from behind. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Mud Bomb
moves.description: The user launches a hard-packed mud ball to attack. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.

moves.name: Psycho Cut
moves.description: The user tears at the foe with blades formed by psychic power. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and rams the foe. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Mirror Shot
moves.description: The user looses a flash of energy from its polished body. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.

moves.name: Flash Cannon
moves.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Rock Climb
moves.description: A charging attack that may also leave the foe confused. It can also be used to scale rocky walls.

moves.name: Defog
moves.description: Obstacles are moved, reducing the foe’s evasion stat. It can also be used to clear deep fog, etc.

moves.name: Trick Room
moves.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

moves.name: Draco Meteor
moves.description: Comets are summoned down from the sky. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Discharge
moves.description: A flare of electricity is loosed to strike all Pokémon in battle. It may also cause paralysis.

moves.name: Lava Plume
moves.description: An inferno of scarlet flames washes over all Pokémon in battle. It may also inflict burns.

moves.name: Leaf Storm
moves.description: A storm of sharp leaves is whipped up. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Power Whip
moves.description: The user violently whirls its vines or tentacles to harshly lash the foe.

moves.name: Rock Wrecker
moves.description: The user launches a huge boulder at the foe to attack. It must rest on the next turn, however.

moves.name: Cross Poison
moves.description: A slashing attack that may also leave the target poisoned. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Gunk Shot
moves.description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the foe to attack. It may also poison the target.

moves.name: Iron Head
moves.description: The foe slams the target with its steel-hard head. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Magnet Bomb
moves.description: The user launches a steel bomb that sticks to the target. This attack will not miss.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.description: The user stabs the foe with a sharpened stone. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Captivate
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Stealth Rock
moves.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the foe. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description: The user snares the foe with grass and trips it. The heavier the foe, the greater the damage.

moves.name: Chatter
moves.description: The user attacks using a sound wave based on words it has learned. It may also confuse the foe.

moves.name: Judgment
moves.description: The user releases countless shots of light. Its type varies with the kind of Plate the user is holding.

moves.name: Bug Bite
moves.description: The user bites the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

moves.name: Charge Beam
moves.description: The user fires a concentrated bundle of electricity. It may also raise the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Wood Hammer
moves.description: The user slams its rugged body into the foe to attack. The user also sustains serious damage.

moves.name: Aqua Jet
moves.description: The user lunges at the foe at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.

moves.name: Attack Order
moves.description: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Defend Order
moves.description: The user calls out its underlings to shield its body, raising its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Heal Order
moves.description: The user calls out its underlings to heal it. The user regains up to half of its max HP.

moves.name: Head Smash
moves.description: The user delivers a life-endangering head butt at full power. The user also takes terrible damage.

moves.name: Double Hit
moves.description: The user slams the foe with a tail, etc. The target is hit twice in a row.

moves.name: Roar of Time
moves.description: The user blasts the foe with power that distorts even time. The user must rest on the next turn.

moves.name: Spacial Rend
moves.description: The user tears the foe along with the space around it. This move has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Lunar Dance
moves.description: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its status and HP fully restored.

moves.name: Crush Grip
moves.description: The foe is crushed with great force. The attack is more powerful the more HP the foe has left.

moves.name: Magma Storm
moves.description: The foe becomes trapped within a maelstrom of fire that rages for two to five turns.

moves.name: Dark Void
moves.description: The foe is dragged into a world of total darkness that puts it to sleep.

moves.name: Seed Flare
moves.description: The user generates a shock wave from within its body. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

moves.name: Ominous Wind
moves.description: The user creates a gust of repulsive wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

moves.name: Shadow Force
moves.description: The user disappears, then strikes the foe on the second turn. It hits even if the foe used Protect.

items.name: Net Ball

items.name: Dive Ball

items.name: Nest Ball

items.name: Repeat Ball

items.name: Timer Ball

items.name: Cherish Ball

items.name: Max Repel

items.name: Moon Stone

items.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a thunderbolt pattern.

items.name: Water Stone
items.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is a clear, light blue.

items.name: Leaf Stone
items.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a leaf pattern.

items.name: TinyMushroom

items.name: Big Mushroom
items.description: A large and rare mushroom. It is very popular among certain maniacal fan segments.

items.name: Pearl

items.name: Big Pearl
items.description: A quite-large pearl that sparkles in a pretty silver color. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

items.name: Star Piece
items.description: A shard of a pretty gem that sparkles in a red color. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

items.name: Nugget
items.description: A nugget of pure gold that gives off a lustrous gleam. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

items.name: Heart Scale

items.name: Honey
items.description: A sweet honey with a lush aroma that attracts wild Pokémon when it is used in grass, caves, or on special trees.

items.name: Gooey Mulch

items.name: Dome Fossil

items.name: Armor Fossil

items.name: Skull Fossil

items.name: Dusk Stone

items.name: Dawn Stone
items.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It sparkles like eyes.

items.name: Oval Stone
items.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is shaped like an egg.

items.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

items.name: TM20
items.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems like poison, paralysis, burn, and sleep.

items.name: TM21
items.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

items.name: TM22
items.description: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

items.name: TM23
items.description: The foe is slammed with a sturdy tail of steel. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat if it hits.

items.name: TM24
items.description: A strong electric blast is loosed at the foe. It may also leave the foe paralyzed.

items.name: TM25
items.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

items.name: TM26
items.description: The user sets off an earthquake that hits all the Pokémon in the battle.

items.name: TM27
items.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

items.name: TM28
items.description: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

items.name: TM29
items.description: The foe is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

items.name: TM30
items.description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the foe. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

items.name: TM31
items.description: The user attacks with tough fists, etc. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.

items.name: TM32
items.description: The user begins moving so quickly that it creates illusory copies to raise its evasiveness.

items.name: TM33
items.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

items.name: TM34
items.description: The user strikes the foe with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

items.name: TM35
items.description: The foe is scorched with an intense blast of fire. The target may also be left with a burn.

items.name: TM36
items.description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the foe. It may also poison the target.

items.name: TM37
items.description: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types.

items.name: TM38
items.description: The foe is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

items.name: TM39
items.description: Large boulders are hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It lowers the foe’s Speed.

items.name: TM40
items.description: The user confounds the foe with speed, then strikes. The attack lands without fail.

items.name: TM41
items.description: The user torments and enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

items.name: TM42
items.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

items.name: TM43
items.description: An attack move with effects that vary depending on the user’s environment.

items.name: TM44
items.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

items.name: TM45
items.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

items.name: TM46
items.description: The user attacks and steals the foe’s held item simultaneously. It can’t steal if the user holds an item.

items.name: TM47
items.description: The foe is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user’s Defense stat.

items.name: TM48
items.description: The user employs its psychic power to exchange abilities with the foe.

items.name: TM49
items.description: The user steals the effects of any healing or status-changing move the foe attempts to use.

items.name: TM50
items.description: The user attacks the foe at full power using fiery energy. It also sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk.

items.name: TM51
items.description: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

items.name: TM52
items.description: The user attacks at full power. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat if it hits.

items.name: TM53
items.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

items.name: TM54
items.description: A restrained attack that prevents the foe from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

items.name: TM55
items.description: If the foe’s HP is down to under half, this attack will hit with double the power.

items.name: TM56
items.description: The user flings its held item at the foe to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

items.name: TM57
items.description: The user attacks with an electric charge. The user may use any remaining electricity to raise its Sp. Atk stat.

items.name: TM58
items.description: The user endures any attack, leaving 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

items.name: TM59
items.description: The foe is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user’s gaping mouth.

items.name: TM60
items.description: An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

items.name: TM61
items.description: The user shoots a sinister, bluish white flame at the foe to inflict a burn.

items.name: TM62
items.description: The foe is attacked with powdery scales blown by wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats.

items.name: TM63
items.description: It prevents the foe from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

items.name: TM64
items.description: The user explodes to inflict damage on all Pokémon in battle. The user faints upon using this move.

items.name: TM65
items.description: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

items.name: TM66
items.description: The user stores power, then attacks. If the user can use this attack after the foe, its power is doubled.

items.name: TM67
items.description: The user recycles a single-use item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

items.name: TM68
items.description: The user charges the foe using every bit of its power. It must rest on the next turn to recover.

items.name: TM69
items.description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It sharply raises the Speed stat.

items.name: TM70
items.description: The user flashes a light that cuts the foe’s accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

items.name: TM71
items.description: The user stabs the foe with a sharpened stone from below. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

items.name: TM72
items.description: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

items.name: TM73
items.description: A weak electric charge is launched at the foe. It causes paralysis if it hits.

items.name: TM74
items.description: The user tackles the foe from a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

items.name: TM75
items.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

items.name: TM76
items.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the foe. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

items.name: TM77
items.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.

items.name: TM78
items.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

items.name: TM79
items.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may also make the target flinch.

items.name: TM80
items.description: Large boulders are hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also make the target flinch.

items.name: TM81
items.description: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

items.name: TM82
items.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

items.name: TM83
items.description: The user draws power from the Berry it is holding to attack. The Berry determines its type and power.

items.name: TM84
items.description: The foe is stabbed with a tentacle or arm seeped with poison. It may also poison the foe.

items.name: TM85
items.description: An attack that works only on a sleeping foe. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user’s HP.

items.name: TM86
items.description: The user snares the foe with grass and trips it. The heavier the foe, the greater the damage.

items.name: TM87
items.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

items.name: TM88
items.description: The user pecks the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user plucks it and gains its effect.

items.name: TM89
items.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

items.name: TM90
items.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

items.name: TM91
items.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it in one shot. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

items.name: TM92
items.description: The user creates a bizarre space in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

items.name: HM01
items.description: The foe is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.

items.name: HM02
items.description: The user soars, then strikes on the second turn. It can also be used to fly to any familiar town.

items.name: HM03
items.description: It swamps the entire battlefield with a giant wave. It can also be used to cross water.

items.name: HM04
items.description: The foe is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move boulders.

items.name: HM05
items.description: Obstacles are moved, reducing the foe’s evasion stat. It can also be used to clear deep fog.

items.name: HM06
items.description: The user slugs the foe with a shattering punch. It can also smash cracked boulders.

items.name: HM07
items.description: The user charges the foe at an awesome speed. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.

items.name: HM08
items.description: A charging attack that may also leave the foe confused. It can also be used to scale rocky walls.

items.name: Explorer Kit
items.description: A bag filled with convenient tools for exploring. It provides access to the Underground.

items.name: Loot Sack
items.description: A sturdy, spacious bag that is used to carry loot obtained in the coal mine.

items.name: Rule Book
items.description: It lists the rules for holding battles. For linked battles, you may choose which set of rules you wish to use.

items.name: Poké Radar
items.description: A tool that can search out Pokémon that are hiding in grass. Its battery is recharged as you walk.

items.name: Point Card
items.description: A card that lists the Battle Points you have earned.

items.name: Journal
items.description: A notebook that keeps a day-to-day record of your adventure so far.

items.name: Seal Case
items.description: A case for storing Seals that can be applied to the capsule cases of Poké Balls.

items.name: Fashion Case
items.description: A fancy case for the tidy and organized storage of colorful Pokémon Accessories.

items.name: Seal Bag
items.description: A tiny bag that can hold ten Seals for decorating Poké Balls.

items.name: Pal Pad
items.description: A convenient notepad that is used for registering your friends, Friend Codes, and keeping a record of game play.

items.name: Works Key
items.description: A large key for operating the doors of the Valley Windworks in the canyon. It was held by a Team Galactic Grunt.

items.name: Old Charm
items.description: An ancient good-luck charm made of Pokémon bones to be taken to the elder of Celestic Town.

items.name: Galactic Key
items.description: A card key for disengaging security systems in the Galactic HQ. Losing it can result in punishment, apparently.

items.name: Red Chain
items.description: A mythical chain that is said to link the legendary Pokémon that created the Sinnoh region.

items.name: Town Map
items.description: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows your  present location.

items.name: Vs. Seeker
items.description: A device that indicates Trainers who want to battle. Its battery charges while you walk.

items.name: Coin Case
items.description: A case for holding Coins obtained at the Game Corner. It holds up to 50,000 Coins.

items.name: Old Rod
items.description: An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

items.name: Good Rod
items.description: A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

items.name: Super Rod
items.description: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

items.name: Sprayduck
items.description: A watering can shaped like a PSYDUCK. It helps promote healthy growth of Berries planted in soft soil.

items.name: Poffin Case
items.description: A case for storing Poffin cooked from Berries.

items.name: Bicycle
items.description: A folding Bicycle that enables much faster movement than the Running Shoes.

items.name: Suite Key
items.description: A key to one of the suites at the luxury hotel by a lake. For some odd reason, it often disappears.

items.name: Oak’s Letter
items.description: A letter from Prof. Oak. Written in it is a request for you to go to Rt. 224.

items.name: Lunar Wing
items.description: A feather that glows like the moon. It is said to possess the power to dispel nightmares.

items.name: Member Card
items.description: A card needed for entering the inn in Canalave City. Oddly, the last date marked on it was 50 years ago.

items.name: Azure Flute
items.description: A flute that puts out echoing sounds that do not seem to be of this world. It is unknown who made it.

items.name: S.S. Ticket
items.description: The ticket required for sailing on the ferry S.S. Anne. It has a drawing of a ship on it.

items.name: Contest Pass
items.description: The pass required for entering Pokémon Contests. It has a drawing of an award ribbon on it.

items.name: Magma Stone
items.description: A stone formed when boulders melted in intensely hot magma, then hardened. Magma remains sealed inside.

items.name: Parcel
items.description: A parcel entrusted in your care. You are supposed to deliver it to your childhood friend who left Twinleaf Town.

items.name: Coupon 1
items.description: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch (Pokétch for short). Three coupons are needed.

items.name: Coupon 2
items.description: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch (Pokétch for short). Three coupons are needed.

items.name: Coupon 3
items.description: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch (Pokétch for short). Three coupons are needed.

items.name: Storage Key
items.description: The key to Team Galactic’s sinister warehouse located at the edge of Veilstone City.

items.name: SecretPotion
items.description: A fantastic medicine dispensed by the pharmacy in Cianwood City. It fully heals a Pokémon of any ailment.

items.name: Vs. Recorder
items.description: An amazing device that can record a battle either between friends or at a special battle facility.

items.name: Gracidea
items.description: A flower sometimes bundled in bouquets to convey gratitude on special occasions like birthdays.

items.name: Secret Key
items.description: A high-tech key that has to be used at a specific location. It emits a special electric signal to open a door.
